name: mom
description: Node.js and SYCL miner built on XMRig hashing sources with MoneroOcean algo switching support
author: MoneroOcean contributors

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck

scriptDescriptions.dev: Incrementally build source workers and run MoM arguments, node/npm commands, or --exec commands: Docker on Linux (MOM_DEV_HOST=1 for native), native on Windows.
scriptDescriptions.build:release: Incrementally build portable Linux or Windows archives natively; -- --clean rebuilds all objects. No tests or publication.
scriptDescriptions.check: Run lint and strict JavaScript/JSDoc type checks.
scriptDescriptions.lint: Check JavaScript code quality and formatting with ESLint.
scriptDescriptions.test: Run check, then correctness tests; select -- host (Linux), -- logic, -- cpu or -- gpu-discrete. No pool mining.
scriptDescriptions.test:perf: Measure available CPU/GPU performance; optionally select an algorithm. Does not enforce README rates.
scriptDescriptions.test:deploy: Build and check release archives: Linux containers/optional Windows VM on Linux, native Windows on Windows. Includes GPU correctness and README performance/CPU-load limits.
scriptDescriptions.typecheck: Check strict JavaScript/JSDoc types without generating files.
